{{Top|leg}}
A '''bow-tie''' is an article of [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] accessory that is worn around the neck of an individual, with the knot being tied in the front in an elaborate manner. The weapons dealer [[Orion Ferret]] wore a bow-tie as part of his formal wear. In addition, the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] F-series droid known as [[F-25-OJSx]] wore a red ornament on the front that was similar in design to a bow-tie. The bow-tie also acted as the partial namesake for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], as the various models in the line, in particular the mainstay fighter line known as the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]], bore a design that resembled the piece of clothing.

==Behind the scenes==
According to ''Star Wars'' creator [[George Lucas]], he coined the term TIE Fighter due to their designs reminding him of bowties.
